decision: Do not claim or run an invented paper-faithful AGCIoU implementation; retain the measured clipped AGCv1/source-function controls as separately labelled geometry controls.

underspecified_choices: score handling when the formula exceeds one

pinned_source_findings.AGCv1: adds raw inverse center distance with a fixed offset and lacks the paper structural terms/activation; singular at coincident centers unless repaired.
pinned_source_findings.AGCv2: has no return in the inspected source body and is not an executable faithful metric.
pinned_source_findings.active_path: the inspected TIDE active matching path uses ordinary bbox IoU helpers; standalone AGCv1/AGCv2 are not the deployed association metric.

measured_control_boundary.interpretation: finite clipped AGCv1/source-function control only; not paper AGCIoU, full TIDE, nonlinear motion, occlusion or novelty evidence.

reason_for_exclusion: Selecting an average scale, epsilon, clipping rule, activation repair or missing active-path integration would add unverified implementation choices and would be a new proxy rather than a source-faithful reproduction. The available primary source and pinned code do not provide enough information for an auditable faithful claim.
scope_closed: Task-book D requirement is closed by explicit source-coverage exclusion; existing fixed-input geometry/UKF/observable-overlap controls remain valid. A learned nonlinear motion model is optional future work only if measured error evidence justifies it.
